objectClass.notes: Observed as a flat 400x400 mascot icon. Route as a custom object-like procedural creature because img2threejs v1.4.1's character template is humanoid-only; using it would invent a torso, neck, clothing, arms, and legs. The model remains a stylized character interpretation, not an exact hidden-side reconstruction. Character settings supply the wooden mallet and confirm the character flies with no legs.

reasoning: The source silhouette is simple, but the runtime hierarchy needs independent pivots for hover, trunk sway, and the BONK mallet swing.
Two paired feature systems (ears and eyes), a rear color cap, a curved trunk, and a compound wooden mallet make the implementation moderate rather than simple.
The single flat view hides depth, rear-cap wrap, appendage roots, and mallet placement, so inferred regions must retain explicit confidence notes.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Moderate depth is required to keep the rounded body, face systems, appendage pivots, and mallet assembly separately addressable without turning a simple mascot into an overbuilt mesh.

acceptedInferences.description: The icon does not reveal body depth; use a shallow ellipsoid whose depth is about 58% of its visible width.
The white rear region is interpreted as a continuous rear ellipsoid cap that wraps around the hidden back.
The trunk is interpreted as a tapered tube leaving the lower-left face and curving downward and slightly forward.
The character file, not the icon, supplies the mallet. Mount a short right-side arm pivot with a detachable wooden mallet.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: Dominant vivid sky-blue rounded body with a near-black silhouette rim.
White rear color zone separated from the blue body by a dark curved boundary.
Small blue rounded tail nub protrudes from the lower-right rear silhouette.
Two solid near-black circular eyes with no pupils, irises, or highlights.
Two small triangular ears break the top silhouette and contain blue inner faces.
A blue tapered trunk emerges from the lower-left face, curves downward, and has a dark outline.
A thick near-black outline surrounds the body, ears, trunk, and rear boundary.

anatomy.note: The humanoid head-unit system is not semantically applicable to this mascot. Values encode one body/head unit and the visible face layout only; implementation uses a custom legless creature hierarchy.

definitionOfDone: The front three-quarter render reads immediately as Yumemin at thumbnail size: vivid blue rounded body, pupil-free dot eyes, two small ears, flexible left-side trunk, white rear cap, and no legs.
The model remains volumetric in side and rear orbit views, with the rear cap wrapping continuously and no flat-card collapse.
Named pivots expose hover, trunk sway, and mallet swing; the mallet can be detached without affecting the body.
All visible meshes are named, clickable, and covered by the runtime parts manifest.

featureGroups.name: Rounded flying body silhouette
qualityCriteria: The body is a horizontally wide, continuous rounded volume with no torso or legs.
The body-to-ear ratio and flattened lower-left trunk notch match the supplied icon.
failureModes: body becomes a sphere, cube, or humanoid torso
three-quarter orbit reveals a flat card

featureGroups.name: Pupil-free dot eyes and ear pair
qualityCriteria: Two solid near-black dot eyes sit on the visible front plane with no pupils, irises, or catchlights.
Two small triangular ears remain separated and legible against the body outline.
failureModes: eyes become glossy spheres with highlights
ear tips are rounded away or oversized

featureGroups.name: Flexible trunk geometry and root pivot
qualityCriteria: A tapered curved tube exits the lower-left face with visible overlap at the root.
The trunk pivots from its facial socket and supports a subtle looping sway.
failureModes: trunk floats or intersects without an intentional root blend
trunk reads as a rigid cone or limb
animation rotates around its center instead of the face socket

featureGroups.name: White rear cap and blue-white boundary
qualityCriteria: The white rear region is a real volumetric cap, not a front decal.
The cap wraps across side and back views with a clean curved blue-white boundary.
failureModes: rear becomes entirely white or entirely blue
white patch floats above the body
side or back shows a blank unmodeled surface

featureGroups.name: Wooden mallet and action-ready hierarchy
qualityCriteria: A short right-side arm/hand pivot holds a wooden mallet with separate handle and head meshes.
The mallet swing socket, impact socket, collider proxies, and detachable destruction group are exposed in sculptRuntime.
Every mesh is named and participates in the shared part-picking/explode manifest.
failureModes: mallet is fused to the body
handle or head floats at a joint
swing rotates around the wrong point
runtime hierarchy is an inert decorative group

visualDeltaChecks: body width/height ratio and continuous rounded silhouette
eye spacing and pupil-free dot treatment
ear size, separation, and top contour
trunk root, curve, taper, and silhouette notch
white rear cap coverage in front, side, and back
matte blue, white, black, and wood palette under neutral lighting
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
